registered_at: see the git commit that adds this file (01/11, +0700)
registered_before: any branch of this protocol is fitted or scored on any dataset
owner_decisions: 01/11: the goal is an ML model that detects blind attacks; rule decision paths (tripwire, novelty checks, votes) are set aside until the ML is decided
01/11: approve every proposal of reports/Cải thiện ML Pulse LID DS.md, including dropping the peer-novelty gate from the ML
01/11: expectations unchanged: recall >= 95 %, precision >= 95 %, latency <= 3 s; benign-binary flagging and alert burden as low as possible
31/10: process: design and select on LID-DS 2021 development + CB-DS, LID-DS 2021 official once, live run, LID-DS 2019 last
seen_before_registration: every v1-v4 result on LID-DS 2021 and CB-DS, the per-scenario ML misses (official ML 63.9 %), the Juice-Shop diagnosis, the deep research report; declared: the official recordings are not unseen for the dataset, only for these configurations
model: per scenario, every branch fitted on the training recordings and calibrated (conformal) on the validation recordings, normal data only: G0 = the current ML (reference tree history 3 + support interval model on the 249 count features); G1 file access (128 hashed directory-prefix bins, read/write, log1p) with a reference tree (history 1); G2 per-thread 5-gram language model of syscall names (Witten-Bell interpolation to an add-one unigram), window score = mean of the 10 highest per-event negative log-probabilities; G3 log2 I/O size buckets (32, log1p) with a reference tree; G4 errno (32 hashed (syscall, errno) bins) with a reference tree. Fix A: trees fitted with activate_fraction 0.05 (a share of the corrupted training rows moves one training-constant coordinate) or 0
decision: branches combined by Bonferroni (min(1, K min p)) or Cauchy; pass at p <= 5 x 0.05/30; alarm on two consecutive contiguous passes (the v1 ML decision); no tripwire, no novelty gate, no vote
reproducibility: the configuration g0 / no fix A / Bonferroni must reproduce the ml arm of the v2 receipts recording by recording on LID-DS 2021 and CB-DS; otherwise the run is not used
split: as lidds-evaluation-v3: development = v2 development attacks + 30 % of test/normal; official = the rest; CB-DS every recording
selection: the highest development recall among eligible configurations; ties to fewer development false alarms, fewer groups, without fix A, Bonferroni; if none is eligible, the highest development recall with development false alarms <= 2 %, reported as not qualified

reported: baseline (current ML) on the same split

known_ceiling: Juice-Shop SQLInjectionUser has no syscall footprint: with Juice-Shop unchanged the ML ceiling is about 93.5 % pooled (report), so the recall criterion may be unreachable
not_measured_here: benign-binary flagging and alert burden: live only (next step), with the peer-novelty gate removed from the ML
next: live: implement the selected branches in the probe (overhead A/B), blind live run vs the current ML on the same data, then LID-DS 2019 once; rules (tripwire, Falco) are integrated and compared only after
